C33.single_construction_path: VerifiedSource.__init__ refuses unless handed a private _SOURCE_FACTORY_TOKEN; the only public entry is from_csv_bytes(raw, roles, source_logical_id).
C33.immutable_fields: __slots__ + __setattr__ that raises 'immutable'; bytes, digest, logical_id, roles, usecols cannot be reassigned after construction.
C33.digest_recomputed: source_digest is always sha256 of the private bytes; never accepted from a caller.
C33.revalidated_at_use: revalidate() re-checks digest==bytes and re-runs require_logical_id at the last point of use inside _build_package.

C34.copy_on_read: frame() re-parses a fresh pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(self._raw), usecols=...) copy on every call; no cached/shared reference is exposed.
C34.mutation_isolation: mutating a returned frame copy cannot alter a later build (verified).
C34.digest_semantics: package digest changes when the bytes change and is deterministic when they do not.
